butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Başlangıç, bütün okumayı Allah’ın adı ve rahmeti altında kurar. Sonraki çoğalma, mezar, görme ve sorgu dizisi bu adı yalnızca giriş formülü olmaktan çıkarır; rahmet, nimetin de hesaba konu olmasını anlamlı kılan üst çerçeveye dönüşür. {س م و B005; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ح م B003}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Başlangıç, bütün okumayı Allah’ın adı ve rahmeti altında kurar. Sonraki çoğalma, mezar, görme ve sorgu dizisi bu adı yalnızca giriş formülü olmaktan çıkarır; rahmet, nimetin de hesaba konu olmasını anlamlı kılan üst çerçeveye dönüşür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:1.** أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ — Birincil okuma: Çoğalma yarışı sizi asıl kaygıdan alıkoymuştur. Mezar, kesin görme ve son soru bağlamı eklenince bu dalgınlık basit zevk değil; servet, sayı, soy ve gösterilebilir itibar üzerinden kurulan bir skor düzeni olarak okunur. {ل ه و B001; ل ه و B003; ك ث ر B002; ك ث ر B003; ر ء ي B005; ع ي ن B011}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Çoğalma yarışı sizi asıl kaygıdan alıkoymuştur. Mezar, kesin görme ve son soru bağlamı eklenince bu dalgınlık basit zevk değil; servet, sayı, soy ve gösterilebilir itibar üzerinden kurulan bir skor düzeni olarak okunur.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:2.** حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ — Birincil okuma: Yarış sizi mezarlara kadar götürmüştür. “Ziyaret” dalı mezarı son sahiplik değil geçici eşik yaparken, sapma ve gizlenme dalları bu varışı yanlış yöne kırılmış bir yolun, sonra açığa çıkarılacak kapalı durağına dönüştürür. {ز و ر B003; ز و ر B001; ز و ر B007; ق ب ر B001; ق ب ر B002}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Yarış sizi mezarlara kadar götürmüştür. “Ziyaret” dalı mezarı son sahiplik değil geçici eşik yaparken, sapma ve gizlenme dalları bu varışı yanlış yöne kırılmış bir yolun, sonra açığa çıkarılacak kapalı durağına dönüştürür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:3.** كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ — Birincil okuma: Hayır; yakında bileceksiniz. Sonraki “ilim-yakîn, görme, göz-yakîn ve soru” sırası bu bilgiyi soyut uyarı olmaktan çıkarır; alıkoyulmuş hakikatin işaretlenip bildirilmesiyle başlayan bir delil sürecine çevirir. {ع ل م B001; ع ل م B002; ل ه و B001; ي ق ن B001; س ء ل B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Hayır; yakında bileceksiniz. Sonraki “ilim-yakîn, görme, göz-yakîn ve soru” sırası bu bilgiyi soyut uyarı olmaktan çıkarır; alıkoyulmuş hakikatin işaretlenip bildirilmesiyle başlayan bir delil sürecine çevirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:4.** ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ — Birincil okuma: Sonra yine hayır; yakında bileceksiniz. Tekrar, yalnız vurgu değil ikinci eşik gibi çalışır; ilerideki görme ve sorgu aşamalarıyla birlikte bilgi, katman katman zorunlu açıklığa ilerleyen bir çağrıya dönüşür. {ع ل م B001; ع ل م B002; ي ق ن B001; ر ء ي B001; س ء ل B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Sonra yine hayır; yakında bileceksiniz. Tekrar, yalnız vurgu değil ikinci eşik gibi çalışır; ilerideki görme ve sorgu aşamalarıyla birlikte bilgi, katman katman zorunlu açıklığa ilerleyen bir çağrıya dönüşür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:5.** كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ — Birincil okuma: Eğer kesin bilginin bilgisiyle bilseydiniz, bu yarış sizi alıkoyamazdı. Cehennemin harareti ve ardından gelen gözle kesinlik, bu bilgiyi içte koruyan, yolu değiştirecek bir sığınak ve işaret olarak gösterir. {ع ل م B001; ع ل م B002; ع ل م B005; ي ق ن B001; ي ق ن B002; ج ح م B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Eğer kesin bilginin bilgisiyle bilseydiniz, bu yarış sizi alıkoyamazdı. Cehennemin harareti ve ardından gelen gözle kesinlik, bu bilgiyi içte koruyan, yolu değiştirecek bir sığınak ve işaret olarak gösterir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:6.** لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ — Birincil okuma: Mutlaka cehennemi göreceksiniz. Sonraki “عين اليقين” bu görmeyi yalnız dışarıdan seyir olmaktan çıkarır; alevin göz, bakış, öfke ve teşhir dallarıyla, seyredenlerin de bakış altında kaldığı bir açıklığa dönüştürür. {ر ء ي B001; ر ء ي B012; ج ح م B001; ج ح م B003; ج ح م B004; ج ح م B005}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Mutlaka cehennemi göreceksiniz. Sonraki “عين اليقين” bu görmeyi yalnız dışarıdan seyir olmaktan çıkarır; alevin göz, bakış, öfke ve teşhir dallarıyla, seyredenlerin de bakış altında kaldığı bir açıklığa dönüştürür.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:7.** ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ — Birincil okuma: Sonra onu kesinliğin gözüyle, doğrudan göreceksiniz. Finaldeki nimet sorgusu bu doğrudanlığı yalnız epistemik kesinlik değil, elde mevcut ve inkâr edilemez delil hâli yapar; görülen şey artık iddia değil, bizzat hesabın konusu olan gerçekliktir. {ر ء ي B001; ع ي ن B001; ع ي ن B002; ع ي ن B011; ع ي ن B013; ي ق ن B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Sonra onu kesinliğin gözüyle, doğrudan göreceksiniz. Finaldeki nimet sorgusu bu doğrudanlığı yalnız epistemik kesinlik değil, elde mevcut ve inkâr edilemez delil hâli yapar; görülen şey artık iddia değil, bizzat hesabın konusu olan gerçekliktir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **102:8.** ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Sonra o gün nimetten mutlaka sorguya çekileceksiniz. Önceki çoğalma, gösteri, mezar, bilgi ve görme çizgisi nimeti soyut bir iyilik olmaktan çıkarır; rahatlık, mal, yerleşme, yürüyüş ve dağılabilen topluluk biçimlerinin hepsini cevap verilecek maddeye çevirir. {س ء ل B001; س ء ل B002; س ء ل B003; ن ع م B001; ن ع م B002; ن ع م B005; ن ع م B011; ن ع م B012}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Sonra o gün nimetten mutlaka sorguya çekileceksiniz. Önceki çoğalma, gösteri, mezar, bilgi ve görme çizgisi nimeti soyut bir iyilik olmaktan çıkarır; rahatlık, mal, yerleşme, yürüyüş ve dağılabilen topluluk biçimlerinin hepsini cevap verilecek maddeye çevirir.

parent_channels.name: Hidden Matters Becoming Known

subchannels.name: Sight Ripening into Certainty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sensory or inward sight yields direct witnessing, knowledge, and settled certainty.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory seeing `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; insight `ر ء ي:B001/m02`; direct witnessing `ع ي ن:B002/m01`; knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; fixed certainty `ي ق ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Perception begins with the act of seeing, deepens into inward insight and direct encounter, and culminates in knowledge from which doubt has been displaced.

subchannels.name: Deliberation Producing Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inward view is turned over through reflection and counsel until it becomes a considered judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: opinion and judgment `ر ء ي:B002/m01`; conjectural assessment `ر ء ي:B002/m02`; deliberation and counsel `ر ء ي:B002/m04`; learning `ع ل م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing is internalized as a mental position, then tested through reflection, consultation, and learning. The result is not merely an image but a judgment formed in the heart.

subchannels.name: Deliberate Disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: One party makes an object or proposition visible so that another can attend to and know it.
subchannels.active_motifs: causative showing `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; mirror presentation `ر ء ي:B012/m02`; teaching and informing `ع ل م:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure has a showing party, an object made present, and an addressee whose attention is summoned. Showing, presenting through a mirror, and informing all enact the transfer of something into another's awareness.

subchannels.name: Vision Beyond Waking Sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hidden content appears through dreams or through an uncanny intermediary associated with divination and treatment.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision `ر ء ي:B003/m01`; jinn apparition `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; divinatory or therapeutic showing `ر ء ي:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The root's visual field opens onto scenes in which the perceiver receives an image rather than seeking an ordinary visible object. Dream and apparition preserve disclosure while changing its setting and intermediary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Something unavailable or uncertain becomes apprehensible through sight, inward judgment, disclosure, or certainty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same disclosure pattern extends from waking perception into deliberation, dream vision, apparition, and deliberate showing.

parent_channels.name: Attention Captured, Redirected, and Performed

subchannels.name: Diversion and Abandonment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or heart is occupied by one thing and consequently leaves or turns away from another.
subchannels.active_motifs: diversion `ل ه و:B001/m01`; turning away `ل ه و:B001/m02`; occupying another `ل ه و:B001/m03`; variant diversion `ل ه ي:B001/m01`; variant abandonment `ل ه ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
subchannels.synthesis: Attention is treated as a limited capacity: occupation by one object produces neglect of another, and repeated occupation hardens into abandonment.

subchannels.name: Absorbing Play
subchannels.scene_or_process: Play and entertainment hold attention through immediate enjoyment.
subchannels.active_motifs: play and enjoyment `ل ه و:B002/m01`; variant amusement `ل ه ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
subchannels.synthesis: The diverting object becomes pleasurable in its own right. Play creates a self-contained scene of enjoyment capable of displacing more consequential attention.

subchannels.name: Intimate and Social Diversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desire is directed toward intimate companions, offspring, or repeated social courtship and conversation.
subchannels.active_motifs: intimate euphemism `ل ه و:B002/m02`; variant intimate euphemism `ل ه ي:B002/m02`; recurrent courtship and conversation `ز و ر:B003/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); 102:2 `زُرْتُمُ` (`ز و ر`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
subchannels.synthesis: Diversion acquires participants and a social setting: the sought pleasure may be a person, a family attachment, or repeated conversational courtship.

subchannels.name: Performing for Public Regard
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor shapes conduct for an audience, while the opposite posture ceases to be restrained by shame.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostentatious display `ر ء ي:B005/m01`; reputation-seeking `ر ء ي:B005/m02`; diminished shame `ج ح م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Public regard becomes a social force. One person stages an act to be seen or heard of, while another acts with little restraint from the same observing public.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Attention is drawn away from one object, absorbed by pleasure, redirected toward social desire, or deliberately solicited from an audience.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` names diversion, while 102:6-7 `لَتَرَوُنَّ` and `لَتَرَوُنَّهَا` provide the contrasting field of compelled attention.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Diversion ranges from inward neglect to play, intimate attraction, reputation management, and the refusal of social shame.

parent_channels.name: Increase, Rivalry, and Material Throughput

subchannels.name: Growth into Abundance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A quantity grows, is made numerous, or is deliberately accumulated until it becomes a gathered abundance.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundance `ك ث ر:B001/m01`; multiplication `ك ث ر:B001/m02`; seeking accumulation `ك ث ر:B001/m03`; addition `ن ع م:B010/m01`; intensification `ن ع م:B010/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Increase can be a state, an operation, or an appetite. Repeated addition produces a compact whole, while intensification marks the same movement in the force of an action.

subchannels.name: Competitive Outnumbering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Groups face one another and seek superiority through number, wealth, honor, or knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: outnumbering `ك ث ر:B002/m01`; rivalry and boasting `ك ث ر:B002/m02`; reciprocal facing `ر ء ي:B004/m01`; contest in knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity becomes relational when opposed parties face each other. Counting, display, and comparison turn abundance into a contest whose prize is precedence.

subchannels.name: Proliferating Speech and Claims
subchannels.scene_or_process: Verbal production or repeated demands accumulate around a speaker or a person burdened by claimants.
subchannels.active_motifs: prolific speech `ك ث ر:B003/m02`; crowding claimants `ك ث ر:B003/m03`; repeated questioning `س ء ل:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Multiplicity migrates from possessions into discourse. Words can become excessive, and questions or claims can multiply until the person addressed is surrounded by demand.

subchannels.name: Grain, Mill, and Gift Throughput
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated portions of grain are fed into a mill, with gifts or coins understood through the same image of measured input.
subchannels.active_motifs: grain cast into a mill `ل ه و:B003/m01`; variant mill-feed `ل ه ي:B004/m01`; gift or coins as portions `ل ه و:B003/m02`; abundant giving `ل ه و:B003/m03`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity becomes operational: small units are continually supplied to an opening and transformed. The image then carries over from grain to money and repeated giving.

subchannels.name: Dense Masses in Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fine particles gather into a dense, rising, or intensely concentrated mass.
subchannels.active_motifs: rising dust cloud `ك ث ر:B005/m01`; extreme concentration `ك ث ر:B005/m02`; compact gathering `ك ث ر:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dust makes abundance visible as particulate density. The scene joins accumulation with motion rather than with static counting.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Units multiply, gather into a mass, become a basis for rivalry, or pass through a mechanism that converts quantity into output.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 102:1 `ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ` presents reciprocal increase as the opening action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Quantity appears not only as number and wealth but also as speech, claimants, grain, gifts, and rising dust.

parent_channels.name: Inquiry, Desire, and Response

subchannels.name: Interrogation and Mutual Questioning
subchannels.scene_or_process: An addressee is called to answer, or several participants question one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: inquiry `س ء ل:B001/m01`; mutual questioning `س ء ل:B004/m01`; attention-seeking inquiry formula `ر ء ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Questioning creates a discourse scene with accountable participants. The attention formula supplies the summons, while direct and reciprocal questions organize who must speak.

subchannels.name: Need Becoming a Request
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inward want is identified as a desired object and then directed toward someone able to provide it.
subchannels.active_motifs: request `س ء ل:B001/m02`; asking through or about a person `س ء ل:B001/m03`; desired object or need `س ء ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The question-root also structures desire: a need becomes definite, an addressee is selected, and the want is voiced as a request.

subchannels.name: Fulfillment and Benefaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: The requested need is met by an act of granting or benefaction.
subchannels.active_motifs: fulfillment of a request `س ء ل:B003/m01`; benefaction to another `ن ع م:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Request and favor form two sides of one transfer. The asker's lack is answered by a giver who completes the matter and conveys benefit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A question opens a relation between asker and addressee, becomes a request for a desired object, and may end in fulfillment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 102:8 `لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ` places questioning at the surah's final turn.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Inquiry expands from information-seeking into mutual dialogue, desiderata, intercession, and the granting of a need.

parent_channels.name: Movement, Visitation, and Resting Places

subchannels.name: Fast and Pedestrian Travel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler advances either with speed or directly on foot, with the feet bearing the cost of movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: rapid travel `ز و ر:B007/m01`; pedestrian journey `ن ع م:B012/m01`; worn feet `ن ع م:B012/m02`; light walking `ن ع م:B012/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Travel is differentiated by manner: forceful speed contrasts with unmounted movement, while foot-wear and lightness register the body's participation in the journey.

subchannels.name: Visit and Reception
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visitor intentionally approaches another party and enters a social frame of reception and hospitality.
subchannels.active_motifs: visit and visitor `ز و ر:B003/m01`; guest hospitality `ز و ر:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Visiting has direction, an arriving participant, and a receiving side. Hospitality develops the destination from a place into a social encounter.

subchannels.name: Settlement and Final Emplacement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Arrival resolves into a fitting place of residence or into burial within a grave and cemetery.
subchannels.active_motifs: congenial land `ن ع م:B011/m01`; pleasant settlement `ن ع م:B011/m02`; grave as resting place `ق ب ر:B001/m01`; burial `ق ب ر:B001/m02`; provision of a grave `ق ب ر:B001/m03`; cemetery `ق ب ر:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Residence and burial share the operation of assigning a body to a place. One setting welcomes continued dwelling; the other receives the dead and fixes their final station.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Directed movement culminates in arrival, social reception, settlement, or emplacement in a final resting place.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 102:2 joins `زُرْتُمُ` with `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ` in a single movement toward graves.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The movement ranges from speed and foot travel to hospitality, congenial residence, burial, and the provision of a grave.

parent_channels.name: Heat as an Escalating Force

subchannels.name: Blaze, Embers, and Hot Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire flares, embers multiply, and the surrounding place becomes intensely hot.
subchannels.active_motifs: blazing fire `ج ح م:B001/m01`; massed embers `ج ح م:B001/m02`; intensely hot place `ج ح م:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Combustion is rendered as both process and environment: flame intensifies, glowing material accumulates, and heat defines the place containing it.

subchannels.name: Battle at Full Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conflict reaches a state of violent intensity in which severe fighting produces death.
subchannels.active_motifs: raging warfare `ج ح م:B002/m01`; killing and death in battle `ج ح م:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The blaze is translated into collective violence. Battle supplies the setting, fury the process, and death the terminal outcome.

subchannels.name: Anger Igniting the Face
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inner anger rises as heat and becomes visible in the face and an aggressive nasal posture.
subchannels.active_motifs: face inflamed by anger `ج ح م:B004/m01`; nose-raised anger posture `ق ب ر:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: An inward emotional surge is externalized through heated facial appearance and a projecting posture, making anger bodily legible.

subchannels.name: The Burning Gaze
subchannels.scene_or_process: An eye opens wide, reddens, fixes, or sharpens its look until vision itself takes on the force of flame.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide fixed eye `ج ح م:B003/m02`; red and sharpened gaze `ج ح م:B003/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Combustive intensity is transferred to ocular behavior. Heat no longer consumes external matter but concentrates in the eye's color, width, and unwavering direction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat intensifies from material combustion into destructive conflict, bodily anger, and a burning or fixed gaze.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire becomes a model for warfare, facial inflammation, anger, and the eye's severe visual force.

parent_channels.name: Eye Forms and Regimes of Regard

subchannels.name: Eye, Sight, and Ocular Condition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A physical eye performs sight, carries visible beauty, or enters a diseased state.
subchannels.active_motifs: eye organ `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; sight and looking `ع ي ن:B001/m02`; wide beautiful eye `ع ي ن:B016/m01`; ocular disease `ج ح م:B003/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The eye is simultaneously a component, an operation, and a visible state. Beauty enlarges and refines it, while disease marks the same organ through impairment.

subchannels.name: Protective and Harmful Regard
subchannels.scene_or_process: Directed regard either keeps someone under care and honor or harms a watched person through the evil eye.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective watching `ع ي ن:B003/m01`; harmful eye action `ع ي ن:B004/m01`; afflicted target `ع ي ن:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The relation between watcher and watched reverses polarity. One gaze preserves and shelters; the other transmits injury and leaves a marked victim.

subchannels.name: Watchers and Present Witnesses
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group sends an observer for information, while the presence or absence of people determines whether a place is socially watched.
subchannels.active_motifs: spy, scout, or watchman `ع ي ن:B005/m01`; present person or household `ع ي ن:B017/m01`; gathered people `ع ي ن:B017/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The eye becomes a human role. A designated watcher extends collective perception, and a populated place becomes an environment in which witnessing is possible.

subchannels.name: Reflection and Eye-Shaped Geometry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reflection or circular and recessed form allows non-ocular objects to function or appear like an eye.
subchannels.active_motifs: mirror `ر ء ي:B006/m01`; visible appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m02`; solar disk `ع ي ن:B008/m01`; eye-shaped socket or notch `ع ي ن:B009/m01`; visible balance tilt `ع ي ن:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The eye supplies both a viewing function and a shape template. Mirrors return appearance, the sun presents a luminous disk, and recessed or tilted components reproduce ocular geometry in tools and structures.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The eye functions as organ, beautiful form, caring or harmful regard, observer, and model for reflective or circular structures.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ocular meaning extends from sight into protection, envy, espionage, household presence, mirrors, the sun, sockets, and balance tilt.

parent_channels.name: Marks, Identity, and Rank

subchannels.name: Distinguishing and Guiding Marks
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sign differentiates an object, guides a traveler, fixes a boundary, or is deliberately applied to a surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: distinguishing mark `ع ل م:B002/m01`; landmark and path guide `ع ل م:B002/m03`; boundary marker `ع ل م:B002/m04`; applied marking `ع ل م:B002/m05`
subchannels.synthesis: A mark makes location and identity readable. It can be encountered as a guide or boundary, or produced as an intentional inscription on clothing, equipment, or the body.

subchannels.name: Standards and Public Authority
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised sign makes a collective center visible, while a chief or reference figure gives the group a point of return.
subchannels.active_motifs: banner as mark `ع ل م:B002/m02`; raised standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; chief or authority `ز و ر:B005/m01`; point of reference `ز و ر:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Public order is organized around something conspicuous. The banner locates the group in space, and the leader performs the same centering function in counsel and command.

subchannels.name: Identity, Selection, and Social Class
subchannels.scene_or_process: One entity is singled out from a whole, or people are classified by rank and kinship.
subchannels.active_motifs: the thing itself `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; selected member `ع ي ن:B013/m02`; nobles `ع ي ن:B015/m01`; full siblings `ع ي ن:B015/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Identification can isolate an exact object or establish a human category. Selection, nobility, and shared parentage all answer which member or class is meant.

subchannels.name: Appearance as a Sign
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible feature on the face announces an otherwise hidden state or identity.
subchannels.active_motifs: facial sign `ر ء ي:B006/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The face operates as a marked surface: an internal condition becomes readable through an outward feature, linking appearance to recognition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Visible or conceptual marks distinguish entities, orient movement, identify public authority, and classify social standing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the relevant roots occur at 102:2 `زُرْتُمُ`, 102:3-5 `تَعْلَمُونَ` and `عِلْمَ`, 102:6-7 `لَتَرَوُنَّ` and `لَتَرَوُنَّهَا`, and 102:7 `عَيْنَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A single identifying logic connects cloth marks, road guides, boundaries, banners, chiefs, selected objects, nobles, and full siblings.

parent_channels.name: Containment, Hidden Interiors, and Release

subchannels.name: Recessed and Embedded Matter
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object lies below, within, or behind an outer surface and is difficult to expose directly.
subchannels.active_motifs: depressed hidden ground `ق ب ر:B002/m01`; fruit embedded in fronds `ق ب ر:B002/m02`; hollow decayed wood `ق ب ر:B002/m03`; enclosure within solid skin `ق ب ر:B002/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment appears in terrain, plant growth, material decay, and bodily covering. Each scene places an object beneath a containing exterior.

subchannels.name: Protected Seclusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young woman is kept within a protected, screened interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: secluded protected maiden `ي ق ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Containment becomes a social arrangement: protection is enacted spatially by limiting exposure and access.

subchannels.name: Internal Organ and Affliction
subchannels.scene_or_process: The lung occupies an internal bodily chamber and becomes the site of complaint or disease.
subchannels.active_motifs: lung `ر ء ي:B009/m01`; pulmonary affliction `ر ء ي:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The body contains a hidden organ whose presence becomes salient through illness, turning an unseen interior component into the center of a bodily event.

subchannels.name: Waterskin Aperture, Leak, and Seal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thin point or hole in a skin vessel releases water and can be closed through a water-based sealing action.
subchannels.active_motifs: waterskin aperture `ع ي ن:B007/m01`; leaking flow `ع ي ن:B007/m02`; sealing with water `ع ي ن:B007/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The containing boundary is defined by its failure and repair. Water passes from inside to outside through a weak point, then participates in closing that point.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Matter or persons are recessed, enclosed, protected, or held behind a boundary that may also open and leak.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active lexical senses arise from roots occurring at 102:2 `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ`, 102:5 and 102:7 `ٱلْيَقِينِ`, 102:6-7 `لَتَرَوُنَّ` and `لَتَرَوُنَّهَا`, and 102:7 `عَيْنَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ground, fruit, decayed wood, skin, a protected chamber, a lung, and a waterskin all share an inside-outside organization.

parent_channels.name: Sources, Flow, and Weather

subchannels.name: Deep and Emergent Fluids
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fluid is massively contained in a sea or well, or issues visibly from a spring-like source.
subchannels.active_motifs: sea `ع ل م:B005/m01`; abundant well `ع ل م:B005/m02`; spring or source `ع ي ن:B006/m01`; flowing water `ع ي ن:B006/m02`; molten copper issuing as fluid `ع ي ن:B006/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves between reservoir and outlet. Water may be stored in depth or emerge into view, and the same source geometry accommodates a non-water fluid.

subchannels.name: Cloud, Rain, and Gentle Wind
subchannels.scene_or_process: An atmospheric quarter supplies lasting rain while a soft southern wind carries moisture and ease.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud sector `ع ي ن:B010/m01`; sustained rain `ع ي ن:B010/m02`; gentle south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Air and water form one weather process: cloud direction locates the incoming system, rain gives it duration, and the mild wind supplies its mode of arrival.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Fluid gathers, emerges from a source, or moves through the atmosphere as rain and wind.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active senses extend roots occurring at 102:3-5 `تَعْلَمُونَ` and `عِلْمَ`, 102:7 `عَيْنَ`, and 102:8 `ٱلنَّعِيمِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The source image spans sea, deep well, spring water, molten copper, sustained rain, and a gentle southern wind.

parent_channels.name: Benefit, Approval, and Ease

subchannels.name: Favorable Condition and Gift
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recipient enters a pleasant condition through a boon, gift, or good living.
subchannels.active_motifs: well-being `ن ع م:B001/m01`; boon or gift `ن ع م:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Benefit includes both the transferred good and the condition it creates. Gift becomes lived ease rather than remaining a detached object.

subchannels.name: Softness and Refined Living
subchannels.scene_or_process: Physical softness becomes a quality of food, person, and luxurious way of life.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical softness `ن ع م:B002/m01`; luxurious refinement `ن ع م:B002/m02`; soft food or person `ن ع م:B002/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: A tactile property scales into a mode of living. Smoothness and tenderness characterize both immediate objects and the broader condition of comfort.

subchannels.name: Praise, Assent, and Promise
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker positively evaluates an object, affirms a proposition, or commits through an approving answer.
subchannels.active_motifs: formula of praise `ن ع م:B003/m01`; affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`; agreement or promise `ن ع م:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Favorable value enters discourse. Praise names something good, assent confirms what was said, and promise extends approval into future action.

subchannels.name: Honor as Delight of the Eye
subchannels.scene_or_process: Care or blessing gives the eye repose and makes the honored person a source of delight.
subchannels.active_motifs: delight or coolness of eye `ن ع م:B013/m01`; blessing and honor through the eye `ن ع م:B013/m02`; honor under one's eye `ع ي ن:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Benefit is expressed relationally through the eye: the recipient is honored and the beholder receives calm, pleasure, and emotional repose.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A favorable condition is bestowed, enjoyed, verbally affirmed, or expressed as honor and delight.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 102:8 `ٱلنَّعِيمِ` names the favorable state about which questioning occurs.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Benefit moves between material gift, soft living, praise, affirmative reply, promise, and a blessing formulated through the eye.

parent_channels.name: Wealth, Liquidity, and Possession

subchannels.name: Ready Money and Gold
subchannels.scene_or_process: Value is present and immediately available as cash, dinar, or gold rather than absent as debt.
subchannels.active_motifs: ready cash or property `ع ي ن:B011/m01`; gold and dinar `ع ي ن:B011/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Financial presence is modeled as something “at hand” and inspectable. Liquidity contrasts with value postponed or located elsewhere.

subchannels.name: Deferred Exchange Producing Cash
subchannels.scene_or_process: Credit, lending, or a deferred sale is arranged to obtain present money.
subchannels.active_motifs: credit sale or loan `ع ي ن:B012/m01`; cash-generating deferred transaction `ع ي ن:B012/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The mechanism converts time into liquidity: an obligation is deferred so that cash can appear in the present.

subchannels.name: Livestock as Stored Wealth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Camels and other grazing animals constitute a mobile, living possession.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock and camels `ن ع م:B005/m01`; grazing herd `ن ع م:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Wealth is embodied in animals that must be gathered, moved, and maintained, joining possession to pastoral life.

subchannels.name: Wealth as Social Identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is characterized by abundant property or performs abundance through another person's wealth.
subchannels.active_motifs: wealthy possessor `ك ث ر:B003/m01`; borrowed-wealth pretension `ك ث ر:B003/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Possession becomes a public identity. Genuine abundance and performed abundance occupy the same social scene but differ in the source of what is displayed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Value is held as present money, generated through deferred exchange, embodied in livestock, or displayed through the social identity of a possessor.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the relevant roots occur at 102:1 `ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ`, 102:7 `عَيْنَ`, and 102:8 `ٱلنَّعِيمِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The eye-root's immediacy becomes ready cash, while favor becomes herd wealth and abundance becomes a social persona.

parent_channels.name: Avian Forms, Motion, and Analogy

subchannels.name: Raptors, Larks, and Ostriches
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct bird species occupy predatory, small ground-bird, and large cursorial roles.
subchannels.active_motifs: falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; lark `ق ب ر:B003/m01`; ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical field assembles a concrete avian range: aerial predator, small bird, and large running bird. Their contrasting bodies and modes of life give the channel internal differentiation.

subchannels.name: Flight, Dispersal, and Defeat
subchannels.scene_or_process: The ostrich's departure becomes a model for a group scattering, losing cohesion, or suffering defeat.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich taking flight `ن ع م:B008/m01`; group dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m02`; loss of honor or defeat `ن ع م:B008/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Animal motion supplies a social outcome. A bird's sudden departure is scaled up into collective disintegration and the disappearance of former strength.

subchannels.name: Ostrich-Shaped Structures
subchannels.scene_or_process: Objects and locations receive avian names through resemblance in shape, extension, height, route, or celestial arrangement.
subchannels.active_motifs: well beam `ن ع م:B007/m01`; mountaintop canopy `ن ع م:B007/m02`; sole, tendon, or shin form `ن ع م:B007/m03`; roadway `ن ع م:B007/m04`; lunar stations `ن ع م:B007/m05`
subchannels.synthesis: The ostrich image becomes a portable shape model. It organizes built structures, body parts, terrestrial routes, and positions in the sky without requiring a literal bird in each scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bird identity is elaborated through species, collective movement, and objects named by resemblance to avian form or position.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active bird senses extend roots occurring at 102:2 `ٱلْمَقَابِرَ`, 102:3-5 `تَعْلَمُونَ` and `عِلْمَ`, and 102:8 `ٱلنَّعِيمِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Avian imagery connects raptors, larks, ostriches, defeated or dispersed groups, well structures, anatomy, roads, and lunar stations.

parent_channels.name: Reproductive States Made Legible

subchannels.name: Menstrual and Purity Indicator
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible trace is examined to distinguish menstruation from purity.
subchannels.active_motifs: menstrual indicator `ر ء ي:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing functions diagnostically: a small visible sign classifies a larger bodily state and determines which condition is present.

subchannels.name: Visible Pregnancy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy in a camel or ewe becomes externally apparent through bodily enlargement.
subchannels.active_motifs: pregnancy becoming visible `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; enlarged udder as sign `ر ء ي:B010/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: An internal reproductive condition is inferred from a changing exterior. Bodily form serves as the sign through which hidden development is recognized.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A bodily condition that is not continuously visible becomes knowable through a distinctive outward sign.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; both active senses extend the seeing-root occurring at 102:6-7 `لَتَرَوُنَّ` and `لَتَرَوُنَّهَا`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visual discernment enters intimate biological scenes of menstrual status, purity, pregnancy, and lactational change.

parent_channels.name: Deviation, Curvature, and False Construction

subchannels.name: Turning from Straightness into Falsehood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Directional deviation becomes ethical or propositional departure from truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical or directional deviation `ز و ر:B001/m01`; false speech or testimony `ز و ر:B002/m01`; false idol or object `ز و ر:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A spatial relation supplies a moral one. Moving away from the straight course becomes speaking away from truth or directing allegiance toward a false object.

subchannels.name: Speech Shaped Before Delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker prepares and straightens wording internally, with the same shaping operation able to beautify a lie.
subchannels.active_motifs: preparing and ordering speech `ز و ر:B006/m01`; beautifying or fabricating falsehood `ز و ر:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Verbal construction is treated as manual shaping. Preparation can produce orderly expression, but the same craft can give deceptive material an attractive form.

subchannels.name: Bent Fronts and Fittings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Curvature appears in places, tools, the chest, and equipment attached across an animal's front or mouth.
subchannels.active_motifs: bent places and implements `ز و ر:B001/m02`; chest or upper front `ز و ر:B004/m01`; chest inclination `ز و ر:B004/m02`; camel chest and mouth fittings `ز و ر:B004/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Deviation becomes visible geometry. Curved objects and the inclined chest share a bent front, while attached fittings turn that geometry into a practical restraint mechanism.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Departure from a straight line becomes a model for falsehood, fabricated speech, and bent bodily or material form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active senses extend the visit-root occurring at 102:2 `زُرْتُمُ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: One root traverses directional deviation, moral and verbal falsity, rhetorical preparation, curved tools, the chest, and animal fittings.

parent_channels.name: S1. Mouth Threshold and Uvula
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The upper lip and uvula define the entrance and rear threshold of the mouth and throat.
parent_channels.active_motifs: uvula `ل ه و:B004/m01`; variant uvula `ل ه ي:B005/m01`; upper-lip cleft `ع ل م:B004/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 102:1 `أَلْهَىٰ` (`ل ه و`); 102:3-5 `تَعْلَمُونَ` and `عِلْمَ` (`ع ل م`); no separately tagged `ل ه ي` surface occurrence
parent_channels.synthesis: A front cleft and a rear hanging component articulate the oral passage as a bounded anatomical channel through which swallowing and vocal flow must pass.

parent_channels.name: S2. Predatory and Wild Animal Figures
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wild animals are distinguished through species identity and conspicuous ocular presence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: lion's paired eyes `ج ح م:B003/m01`; male hyena `ع ل م:B007/m01`; wide-eyed wild cattle `ع ي ن:B016/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene gathers strong or alert wild creatures through the identifying force of the gaze: the lion is evoked by its eyes, the hyena by sex and species, and wild cattle by ocular form.

parent_channels.name: S3. Palm Core and Emerging Growth
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The palm contains an edible inner core and an emerging inflorescence treated as concentrated plant growth.
parent_channels.active_motifs: palm pith and inflorescence `ك ث ر:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Abundance contracts into a botanical component: the palm's inner material and new growth hold the tree's generative potential in a compact form.
